cohort: Normotensive and hypertensive women bearing a live, full-term fetus who underwent labor induction with misoprostol
finding: Maternal and perinatal outcomes were similar between hypertensive and normotensive women who underwent labor induction with misoprostol.
mod_finding: No significant differences in maternal outcomes were found based on mode of delivery; however, a first-minute Apgar score <7 was less common with vaginal deliveries in normotensive women.
